Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia: Physical examination findings: symmetrical frontal and maxillary bossing, symmetric soft tissue bulge of the hard palate, broad forearms, sausage-like fingers, and bowing of both legs with saber shins
Skull X-rays and CT scans with bone windows: diffuse thickening of the inner and outer tables of all the skull bones with a widened diploe
Facial deformities include nasal blockage, mouth breathing, mild snoring, and progressive bowing of the shins
History of facial deformities since early childhood
Nasal bridge: flat and elevated due to soft tissue thickening
Chief complaint: quadriparesis following a bicycle accident

Achondroplasia: caudal narrowing of the interpedicular distance
